subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should this PR be adapted and landed as the canonical fix for the remaining Google/Gemini auth-profile service-unit credential exposure, using the current #96065 render-policy shape?
rationale: The patch touches credential rendering and now overlaps a merged security-sensitive service-env fix, so maintainer intent is needed before choosing the canonical current-main behavior.

options.title: Adapt And Land
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, preserve the merged config SecretRef policy, add the remaining auth-profile file-backed coverage, and refresh staged-systemd proof.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want all provider auth-profile env refs handled generically rather than limiting this fix to Google/Gemini keys.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the merged config SecretRef fix fully covers the intended scope and auth-profile env refs are out of scope.

recommendation.title: Adapt And Land
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, preserve the merged config SecretRef policy, add the remaining auth-profile file-backed coverage, and refresh staged-systemd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main render-policy commits in the merged overlapping fix, so they are the best available owner for the adaptation decision.
